code: import{useEffect,useState}from"react";import{DATA_PATH}from"../config";export default function useDomains(){const[domains,setDomains]=useState([]);const[updated,setUpdated]=useState(null);const[loading,setLoading]=useState(true);const[error,setError]=useState(null);useEffect(()=>{setLoading(true);fetch(DATA_PATH).then(res=>{if(!res.ok)throw new Error("Failed to fetch domain data.");return res.json();}).then(data=>{setDomains(data.results||[]);setUpdated(data.updated);setLoading(false);}).catch(err=>{console.error("Error loading domains:",err);setError(err.message);setLoading(false);});},[]);return{domains,updated,loading,error};}
